task: A booking desk needs to know which rooms can take a stay. Working on five simulated listing rows, build the code that checks whether a room is open, refuses a stay that includes a closed day, and saves accepted stays to a SQLite file.

produce.name: desk.py
produce.about: The listing model, the open check, the booking rule and the SQLite save and read.

produce.name: main.py
produce.about: Books a stay only when it is accepted and prints the saved days.

steps.P05.m1: Describe a listing as a dictionary of room, day and open flag.
steps.P05.m2: Check whether a room is open on a day.
steps.P05.m3: Accept a stay only when every day in it is open.
steps.P05.m4: Save a booking to SQLite, one row per day, and read the days back in order.
steps.P05.m5: Report the booked days, which hold only accepted stays.

problems: The oak room is closed on 3 June.
The elm room has no row for 3 June, so a missing day must count as not open.
Open is written as the word yes or no, not as True or False.
